before: Foreign run and paragraph property children and attributes could set formatting by local name. A formatting edit rewrote a foreign child such as e:b as w:b, or removed it.
after: Only w: qualified children and attributes set run and paragraph properties. A formatting edit keeps foreign children unchanged on every replica.
reason: Shared data, operation fields, and the representation of run properties stay unchanged. Released readers read the corrected writes the same way, and the regression tests check concurrent edits and a late joiner.
